en.title: Taxi Overturns Before Tebet Toll Gate, Driver Suspected of Drowsiness
en.summary: A green taxi overturned near Tebet 2 toll gate after the driver allegedly fell asleep. There were no fatalities, and drivers were advised to rest when tired.

en.title: Third Day of Search Operation, 129 Virgo Ship Victims Still Missing
en.summary: The search and rescue operation for KM Virgo Transport 8 continued into its third day with 129 people still unaccounted for. Search efforts at sea persisted despite adverse weather conditions.

en.title: Search and Rescue on Viral Capsized Ship Near Anak Krakatau: No Results
en.summary: A content creator posted a video of an object allegedly depicting a capsized ship near Anak Krakatau volcano. The search and rescue team determined the investigation was inconclusive.

en.summary: Indonesia's anti-corruption agency seized approximately 106.3 billion rupiah during an operation investigating alleged bribery related to land rights at Summarecon. The seized money was displayed in suitcases and boxes.
